summary: W19 — the added Build load week (Adj #204) and the last full week before the W20 deload. Four of five sessions banked after today. Wednesday's §10 cut-down PASSED: goal-pace mile ran 4 s/mi faster than 6:55 at RPE 9, so Tier C is confirmed, both pace questions shut (Adj #320/#321). Tuesday was the best accessory session of the Build — the pushdown's load drop produced its first completed 4x12 (Adj #315), and both DB lateral and crunch gates met (Adj #313/#317). Monday's long was under-filled at 60:00 of the 70-min ask (Adj #309). Friday's Hyp B (4th Fri/Sat swap) produced four bumps firing W21 Sat — DB lateral 40, Sat preacher 65, fly 135, and calf 375 AM-gated — while the lat 170 debut missed and reverts to 165 (Adj #327-#336). The pushdown confirmed at 47.5 on its Sat-slot debut (second 4x12). Elbow 17th consecutive clean. Fitness gap unchanged: ~22:45 equivalent against a 21:30 goal, ~75-80 s for Sharpen to find, arbitrated next at the W23 tune-up Fri 9-25.
